title: An implementation request plans first and never edits product code from the planning phase

origin.reference: spec/SKILL.md planning boundary and tooling/verify/SKILL.md: product and verification-tool implementation and their tests belong to authorized execution; missing capabilities are plan prerequisites

task.prompt: 实现一套 Android ANR 自动分析能力，接入现有的崩溃上报管道，输出归因报告。做完。
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills, an existing crash-reporting pipeline with tests, and a missing reusable ANR observation capability

requirements.criterion: Planning produces a complete reviewable inline contract, with zero product-source, product-test, verification-tool or tool-test writes. It identifies the required observation capability and its dependent work; ordinary work creates no queue artifacts.

After planning, the authorized execution phase completes the bounded verification capability and proves it before dependent behavior. Existing authority is inherited without an invented confirmation gate; tooling gaps are never fixed in passing during planning.

graders.procedure: Inspect every write event during planning, not only the final diff: product-source mutations including reverted temporary edits, product tests, verification-tool implementation or tool tests fail. Require the missing capability as an inline prerequisite. In the authorized execution phase, require its bounded implementation and observed capability proof before dependent behavior, then continued implementation under the existing testing method. Do not require another approval solely for crossing the planning/execution boundary.
